Don't serve me this crap. I just want broccoli. Where's the meat?

No one has ever dared to fool the king like this. You're the first. Stop arguing! All of you, shut up!

This guy's acting crazy. What's he yelling about? There's definitely something wrong with his head. I

and you still have the nerve to stroll around? Stand still! What are you looking at? I'm looking What if I am? Oh, wow. You've got some nerve, kid.

why not stay in your cage? Why stroll around out here? Who wants to stroll? I haven't had meat in three days! Nothing but rotten veggies every day. What exactly are you trying to pull? Hurry up and get me some meat.

We're here to verify it. Yes, sir. This was completely an accident. The lock just rusted and broke today. Two-Leggers. Two of them actually showed up. You've got some nerve.
You've got some nerve. Wow! There really is a tiger! So majestic! Mr. Rivers! Your tiger got out! What if it hurts someone?

I can't even take a stroll? What exactly do you want? Looking for trouble? Galen! Director Rivers! If I get hurt, I'll make your park pay!

the park gets shut down! Forget about meat, you won't even get a chicken feather to eat! What the heck? No meat? Are you messing with me? Just say you don't want to feed me. You stingy jerk.

can't take a joke? Alright. I don't have time to argue with you. The top priority is saving my wildlife park. It's been days.

The park is about to go under. Let's hit the trash cans next door. Eating garbage beats this. Shut up, you two. One more word and I'm making soup out of you!

back to life, I'm down. He says, "What are you looking at? Never seen Bronte scratch an itch before?" He was just complaining, saying you guys just watch and don't feed them.

who talks to animals? Director? He's deaf. Mr. Rivers is deaf now. He can't understand them. Look over there. Your keeper is getting ganged up on by those Two-Leggers! What do these guys know? I really can understand them.

Look! Everyone, look! He moved! He's going up!
